changeSet.author: eap
changeSet.comment: Create reliable Order integration event outbox
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE order_service.order_event_outbox ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, event_id UUID NOT NULL, aggregate_id UUID NOT NULL, exchange_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, routing_key VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, payload JSONB NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, next_retry_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, published_at TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uk_order_outbox_event_id UNIQUE (event_id), CONSTRAINT fk_order_outbox_event FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES order_service.order_event_store(event_id), CONSTRAINT ck_order_outbox_status CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'SENT', 'FAILED')), CONSTRAINT ck_order_outbox_attempt_non_negative CHECK (attempt_count >= 0) );
CREATE INDEX idx_order_outbox_pending_retry ON order_service.order_event_outbox(next_retry_at, created_at) WHERE status = 'PENDING'; CREATE INDEX idx_order_outbox_failed ON order_service.order_event_outbox(updated_at) WHERE status = 'FAILED';

changeSet.author: eap
changeSet.comment: Create hot-path Order matching state independent from event-store stream heads
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE order_service.order_matching_state ADD CONSTRAINT ck_order_matching_state_amounts CHECK (remaining_amount >= 0 AND matched_amount >= 0);
INSERT INTO order_service.order_matching_state (order_id, user_id, remaining_amount, matched_amount, status, updated_at) SELECT aggregate_id, user_id, remaining_amount, 0, status, updated_at FROM order_service.order_stream_heads WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND remaining_amount IS NOT NULL AND status IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO NOTHING;

changeSet.author: eap
changeSet.comment: Create durable Order inbox for TradeExecuted events before manual ACK
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE order_service.order_trade_execution_inbox ( trade_id VARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY, legacy_match_id INTEGER, buyer_order_id UUID NOT NULL, seller_order_id UUID NOT NULL, deal_price INTEGER NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RECEIVED', attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, received_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, applied_at TIMESTAMP, last_error TEXT, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT ck_order_trade_execution_inbox_status CHECK (status IN ('RECEIVED', 'APPLIED', 'FAILED_RETRYABLE')), CONSTRAINT ck_order_trade_execution_inbox_attempt_non_negative CHECK (attempt_count >= 0) );
CREATE INDEX idx_order_trade_execution_inbox_status_updated ON order_service.order_trade_execution_inbox(status, updated_at);
